title: cremnophyton molle
intro: Cremnophyton molle, commonly known as the soft-leaved cremanthodium, is a rare plant species found in the Eastern Himalayas. It is an herbaceous perennial plant with soft, woolly leaves, which provides medicinal value to the local communities. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Cremnophyton molle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
